spec.intent: OMP CLAUSE (gloss amended): install ensures omp's 'status' segment is in the host's statusLine.leftSegments in the omp config file omp reads (agent/config.yml, else config.yaml; same surgical, host-owned insertion rules as modelRoles): no key → write omp's default left list (vim, model, mode, path, git, pr) plus status; a list without status → append status; a list with it → untouched; report the change; --dry-run writes nothing. accept: omp install on a config without statusLine writes leftSegments = [vim, model, mode, path, git, pr, status]; on one listing segments without status appends status and changes no other byte; on one with status leaves the file byte-identical; --dry-run writes nothing
